create_grpc_server: create a gRPC server with thread pool, handlers, interceptors, and options using create_server
handle_unary_unary_rpc: handle unary-unary RPC calls by receiving a single request and sending a single response
handle_stream_stream_rpc: handle stream-stream RPC calls by iterating over requests and streaming responses back to clients
abort_rpc_with_status: abort an active RPC call with a specific gRPC status code and error details message
send_initial_metadata: send initial metadata to the client at the start of an RPC call before processing
